commentary: Marketing leaders should prepare for a year defined by AI-driven discovery and engagement: Answer Engine Optimization (also known as Generative Engine Optimization) moves alongside traditional SEO, while LLM reputation management becomes a discipline as AI tools influence research and brand perception. Building resilience to mis- and disinformation is now table stakes, and social customer care becomes critical as consumers increasingly research brands on social platforms. Advances in AI make personalization at scale practical, with measurable uplift for adopters. The guide outlines 15 trends to watch and suggests tracking metrics such as LLM Visibility & Accuracy, Narrative Health, Creator Contribution, Community Share of Voice, Video Effectiveness, and Personalization Lift to operationalize these priorities.

artifacts.expert_comment:
Discovery and brand research are shifting to AI-mediated environments. Answer Engine Optimization now sits alongside SEO, with AI-powered search expected to become the primary consumer discovery channel by 2028. As journalists and influencers increasingly use LLMs for research, LLM reputation management is emerging as a distinct discipline. Leaders should align content, PR, and search around AEO and LLM reputation to influence how brands appear in AI outputs.

Trust and responsiveness move to the foreground. Building resilience to mis- and disinformation is now as fundamental as cybersecurity or data privacy, and social customer care is critical as consumers rely on social platforms to research brands. Decision-making should pair misinformation monitoring with social customer care workflows to address issues within the social channels consumers use for research.
- By 2028, AI-powered search will displace conventional web search as the primary discovery channel.
- More than 70% of worldwide internet users aged 16+ use social platforms to find information about brands.
- AI-driven personalization can deliver around a 2% lift in incremental sales.

Commercial value follows execution at scale. Advances in AI make psychographic segmentation and personalization practical, with around a 2% lift in incremental sales for adopters. To operationalize these priorities, track metrics such as LLM Visibility & Accuracy, Narrative Health, Creator Contribution, Community Share of Voice, Video Effectiveness, and Personalization Lift to put AEO, LLM reputation, misinformation resilience, and social care on a shared scorecard.
artifacts.linkedin_post:
AI-powered discovery is overtaking classic search. By 2028, AI-powered search will displace conventional web search as the primary consumer discovery channel. In 2026, Answer Engine Optimization belongs next to SEO on every roadmap.

What this means for digital leaders:
- Stand up Answer Engine Optimization (also called Generative Engine Optimization) alongside SEO, and track LLM Visibility & Accuracy to understand how your brand shows up in AI answers.
- Treat LLM reputation management as a defined discipline. Journalists and influencers are using LLMs as research aids, which means brand perception is being shaped inside AI outputs.
- Make misinformation resilience a core capability on par with cybersecurity and data privacy. The ability to spot and neutralize false narratives quickly will avoid costly clean-ups.
- Elevate social customer care to protect brand reputation. More than 70% of worldwide internet users aged 16+ use social platforms to find information about brands, and slow responses erode trust.
- Personalize at scale with AI where it is feasible. Advances in AI make psychographic segmentation and micro-targeting practical, and brands can see around a 2% lift in incremental sales. Track Personalization Lift to validate impact.

Use these metrics to operationalize the shift:
- LLM Visibility & Accuracy
- Narrative Health
- Creator Contribution
- Community Share of Voice
- Video Effectiveness
- Personalization Lift

Key data points to anchor plans:
- By 2028, AI-powered search becomes the primary discovery channel for consumers.
- 70%+ of worldwide internet users (16+) rely on social platforms to research brands.
- AI-driven personalization can deliver around a 2% lift in incremental sales.

2026 belongs to leaders who adapt discovery, reputation, resilience, social care, and personalization into one operating system for growth. If your marketing stack and governance do not reflect these realities, you are planning against a market that no longer exists.

#DigitalMarketing #Ecommerce #AI
